title: Length Bound for the Emitted Split
statement: For all natural numbers $C,c$ and every binary word $y$, the word emitted by the polynomial split procedure has length at most $2|y|+2$.
replaced: For all natural numbers $C, c$ and every binary string $y$, the word emitted by the polynomial split emitter on $y$ has length at most $2|y| + 2$.
